entities.name: Ágnes Molnár
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dr. Ágnes Molnár is a Hungarian politician, member of the National Assembly (MP) from Fidesz Győr-Moson-Sopron County Regional List from 2006 to 2014, and her party's national list since 2014. She served as Secretary of State for National Development between 2 June 2010 and 29 June 2012.

entities.summary: Dr. Ágnes Molnár is a Hungarian politician, member of the National Assembly (MP) from Fidesz Győr-Moson-Sopron County Regional List from 2006 to 2014, and her party's national list since 2014. She served as Secretary of State for National Development between 2 June 2010 and 29 June 2012.
